details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If the instructions themselves define the wrong labels, example selection alone is insufficient; repair the contract before testing demonstrations.
details.errorCorrection: Frequency-only selection misses the known boundary; duplicate examples waste the context budget; demonstration-set scoring cannot establish transfer.
details.mechanismOrProperty: Anthropic recommends examples that are relevant, diverse, and structured, and encourages evaluating their relevance and diversity.

messages.text: Ordinary phrases already work and do not teach the negation boundary that causes the observed errors.

feedback.reason: With only three slots, example selection must expose the missing negation boundary rather than repeat already successful patterns. Independent mixed-slice checks establish whether the chosen demonstrations generalize.

options.text: Fill all three slots with the most frequent ordinary phrases, preserving the existing distribution.
